breakdown.description: The prompt uses the polar moment J in the Euler buckling formula, even though Euler buckling depends on the flexural second moment I.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the area moment of inertia I = π d^4/64 in the Euler buckling formula, instead of the polar moment J = π d^4/32 that was incorrectly specified in the incomplete prompt. This aligns with the ground truth.

breakdown.description: The prompt multiplies the critical load by the factor of safety to obtain the allowable load, whereas the allowable load should be the critical load divided by the factor of safety.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly states P_allow = P_cr / n (dividing by the factor of safety), rather than multiplying by it as the incomplete prompt incorrectly suggested. This matches the ground truth formulation.
